review.why: Creates, edits and reviews Word documents: docx-js, XML edits, tracked changes, comments and render checks.
review.summary: Guide to create, edit and read .docx files: docx-js pitfalls (page size, tables, lists, headings, TOC), editing by unpacking and patching XML, tracked changes and comments with helper scripts, schema validation and a render-to-image check. Ships helper scripts and XSD schemas.
strengths: Practical list of docx-js pitfalls that break real documents
Validation and tracked-change checks backed by scripts
Treats .docx from outsiders as untrusted (no unzip)
cautions: Needs node, pandoc, LibreOffice and poppler installed
Licence text is in a separate file not read in this review
Word only: PDFs, spreadsheets and Google Docs are out of scope
